decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-6d976955075b] states one concrete change: a dependabot chore(deps) bump of github/codeql-action from 3.28.12 to 3.28.13 (PR 4607). That is enough to identify the subject, the change and a consequence of none. The same section shows a later bump of the same action from 3.28.13 to 3.28.15 in this release [ev-ddadc146dd66], so the net change across the release is 3.28.12 to 3.28.15. The evidence never explicitly says this is CI-only tooling, or that operators are unaffected. That reading comes from the action's name and the chore(deps) prefix. The item also sits under a "BREAKING CHANGES › What's Changed" heading, but that heading covers the whole 36-item changelog list. So applicability (no customer-environment exposure) can be written, but only by that inference, which is why confidence is low.
